title: 无重叠区间
summary: 删除最少数量的区间，使剩余区间两两不重叠，端点相接不算重叠。
insight: 按结束位置升序选择区间能为后续留下最大空间；每个与当前已选区间重叠的项都删除。
pitfalls: 按结束位置而非起点贪心

solutions.title: 按结束点贪心
solutions.idea: 保留结束最早的兼容区间，统计其余重叠区间。
steps: 维护最后保留区间的 end
start>=end 时保留并更新，否则 removals++

code.java: class Solution { public int eraseOverlapIntervals(int[][] intervals){Arrays.sort(intervals,Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[1]));int end=Integer.MIN_VALUE,removed=0;for(int[] interval:intervals){if(interval[0]>=end)end=interval[1];else removed++;}return removed;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun eraseOverlapIntervals(intervals:Array<IntArray>):Int{intervals.sortWith(Comparator.comparingInt{it[1]});var end=Int.MIN_VALUE;var removed=0;for(interval in intervals){if(interval[0]>=end)end=interval[1] else removed++};return removed} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int eraseOverlapIntervals(vector<vector<int>>& intervals){sort(intervals.begin(),intervals.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return a[1]<b[1];});int end=INT_MIN,removed=0;for(auto& interval:intervals){if(interval[0]>=end)end=interval[1];else ++removed;}return removed;} };
